question: Gochi festival is an Indian festival majorly celebrated in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 'Gochi' festival is celebrated in Himachal Pradesh__.

 __
 
• ​It is also called Gotsi.
 
 
 
• Gochi is celebrated in the Chandra and Bhaga valleys by families which have had a boy child in the preceding year.
 
• The festival is usually celebrated during the month of February every year.
 
• In this festival, token marriages of children below the age of six are also performed.
 
• A special cake is prepared and placed on a large plate and carried by four men to the village shrine.
 
 
• The priest makes a prayer to the God with a bow and arrow.
 
• The cake is then broken down to appease the deity.
 
 
 
• The entire festival is accompanied by the beats of drums known as Lohar.
